description:
Happy Hotel is a fast-paced horror mini-game collection that dares you to survive the handcrafted, unpredictable floors of a haunted hotel. Blending thrilling platforming, quick-thinking puzzles, and suspenseful surprises, it delivers a chilling and unforgettable experience.

Each playthrough presents a fresh selection of handcrafted challenges, from precise platforming and mind-bending puzzles to tense encounters with Happy—the sinister bunny doll who’s always watching. Whether you’re taking on quick 15-minute attempts or enduring longer, nerve-testing runs, Happy Hotel offers a replayable horror experience filled with suspense and dread.

Can you escape the hotel’s horrors, or will you succumb to the watchful gaze of Happy?
name: Happy Hotel
intro: Escape a haunted hotel—and the bunny that won’t let you leave alive.
